levels.title: Suspicious Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the bot1 host and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services responsible for periodic external communication.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services. The suspicious service is likely named `bot-beacon-xnxnxnxnxnxnxnxni386xnxn.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently created services.

hints.title: Second hint title

hints.title: Third hint title

levels.title: Suspicious Flood Service Discovery
levels.content: Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic on the bot1 host.
levels.solution: Examine the systemd timers and services for any that might be related to network diagnostics or probes. The suspicious service is likely named `bot-flood-xnxnxnxnxnxnxnxni386xnxn.service`.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service identified in Task 1 is automatically started after reboot.
levels.solution: Look for systemd timers or other scheduled tasks that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service. The persistence mechanism is likely a systemd timer named `bot-beacon-xnxnxnxnxnxnxnxni386xnxn.timer`.
